title: CRIC Cross-Document Requirements Traceability Matrix
summary: Matrix mapping 41 numbered CRIC constitutional requirements (R-001..R-041) to their primary and supporting PRD specifications and v0.1 verification tests.
notes: Dominant signal is a numbered requirement register (R-001..R-041) with per-requirement verification criteria, under the docs/CRIC-PRD-v0.1/ family -> PRD. Competing DOC signal: the document is an index/traceability table whose requirement text is defined in other specs, not here. Competing ADR signal is confined to one row (R-041 marked 'ACCEPTED - Engineering Coordinator ... 2026-09-03T10:04:53Z' with a channel event id); a single accepted-decision annotation does not override the dominant requirements-register structure, so locked remains false. Supporting-specification column entries (e.g. 'Product Vision', 'Core Ontology', 'Agent Commons') are short document names, not paths, so they are not recorded as cross_refs. Filename hash suffix is a stable placeholder, not a computed SHA-256: no Bash/hashing tool available to this agent; uniqueness holds via the slug.
